_comment: Versions tools/watch.py has been told to leave alone for a while. Each entry says why and until
when; once the date passes the version is built again and only failures from that day count.
Nothing here is permanent on purpose: the reason for setting a version aside can go away.

mysql 8.0.45.reason: Oracle published the Linux tarballs without detached signatures, and mysql.py refuses an unverified asset. Retried in case the signatures are added later.
